title: Wood Binding Roots
body:
Syntax: perform wood binding roots <target>

Description: A Wood Release attack that strikes one target. A weakened target deals 15% less damage.  Requires Wood Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 203-235. 45% chance to inflict weakened. Unlocks at level 45. Costs 42 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 14 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
